background_notes.justification: Composition preserves M and Z-linearity. On m⊗a, both (ST)^K and S^K T^K give S(T(m))⊗a. The balanced tensor product is generated additively by pure tensors: it is the quotient of the free abelian group on pairs by the bilinear and balancing relations. Hence agreement on these generators implies equality of linear maps. Iterating the two-factor identity proves the four-factor identity; N007 guarantees all intermediate vectors lie in M.
